---
name: Correction or resolution
about: Report a mathematical error, duplicate, reference correction, or solution
title: '[Problem ID] '
---

### Affected entry

Problem ID and the passage or claim affected.

### Correction or result

Describe the issue and, if possible, the proposed change. For a solution,
explain whether it covers the full statement or a special case.

Proposed status: Open / Partially resolved / Solution claimed / Solved /
Lean verified / Needs verification / Withdrawn. Compare the exact assumptions,
quantifiers, field, arithmetic model and requested bound; state any cases that
remain open.

### Evidence

Primary reference with a DOI or stable link and precise locator, or a
self-contained mathematical explanation. Distinguish a proof claim from an
established result and note any uncertainty.

For Solved, identify the publication or independent audit and whether the
reviewer was an AI agent. For Lean verified, provide the pinned proof revision,
toolchain/dependencies, theorem names, exact-target comparison, reproduction
commands, verification log and axiom report required by
[CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/ajt60gaibb/OpenProblemsInNLA/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#lean-verification). State whether the
checks were rerun or a public record was reviewed.

### Rating implications, if any

Explain any proposed change to difficulty or impact using the README rubric.
